name: Iraqw
notes: Placed so the ancestry graph covers every living ISO 639-3 language. No orthography is claimed; the phoneme inventory follows the cited PHOIBLE inventory (which itself cites a published description): script is Zyyy (undetermined) until a cited description is encoded. Classification and coordinates follow Glottolog. Orthography from an Omniglot chart (c) Simon Ager, https://www.omniglot.com/, extracted via the AfriSpeech/africa-g2p compilation (irk.json). africa-g2p is a compilation tool, not the linguistic authority; the citation above is the original source it names. Iraqw carries lexical tone (PHOIBLE records 3 tone segments) rather than stress; tone is not orthographically marked and is left unencoded, and there is no separate stress system to model (documented exemption).

sources.title: A Grammar of Iraqw
sources.notes: The definitive descriptive grammar of Iraqw. Verified against this spec's orthography: the Swahili-based popular orthography with q/x added, ʕ spelled ⟨/⟩, ɬ spelled ⟨sl⟩, ħ spelled ⟨hh⟩ and tɬʼ spelled ⟨tl⟩ all match the grapheme table exactly (glyphs '/','sl','hh','tl' -> ʕ/ɬ/ħ/t͡ɫ' respectively) — no discrepancy found.
